description: This file defines a React functional component 'RouterConfigBuilder' for configuring routing settings in a UI, including managing routes with models, utterances, descriptions, and thresholds. It leverages Ant Design components and includes state management and dynamic UI rendering.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Interface representing a route configuration with id, model, utterances, description, and score threshold.

classes.name: SavedRoute
classes.description: Interface representing a saved route with optional id, name, model, utterances, description, and score threshold.

classes.name: RouterConfig
classes.description: Interface representing the overall router configuration consisting of a list of routes.

classes.name: RouterConfigBuilderProps
classes.description: Interface for props received by the RouterConfigBuilder component including model info, value, and onChange callback.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a new empty route to the routes list and updates the configuration.

methods.name: removeRoute
methods.description: Removes a route by its ID and updates the configuration.

methods.name: updateRoute
methods.description: Updates a specific field of a route identified by route ID.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Generates and calls onChange callback with the current routes configuration.

methods.name: handleUtterancesChange
methods.description: Handles changes in utterances textarea, updating the route with a string converted to an array.

methods.name: generateConfig
methods.description: Creates a simplified routes configuration object for JSON preview.
